title: The green coat on the chair
logline: The folding chair on the dock with a green coat over its back. Nobody in it yet. The Lisbon coat, the invented one, here, real. The page doesn't remark.

panels.composition: The dock at evening: Maria's lawn chair, and beside it a folding chair with a green coat over its back, both empty, the bay beyond. The coat's green the page's one saturated color.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a wooden dock at evening with an old lawn chair and a folding chair side by side both empty, a green coat draped over the folding chair's back as the only strong color, bay beyond, no words
image.notes: The green coat from ro_2022-01-16, real now. Not remarked.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
